rationale: All three acceptance criteria pass and no code logic issues were found by any lens. One CI-blocking standards violation: both commit messages use a lowercase first word after the colon ('show-scroll' and 'initialise'), violating the enforced git-workflow format. Tekton CI will block the MR merge. One blind-lens corruption artifact dismissed (diff I provided had a duplicate sidebarExpanded check not present in the actual code). One style note (if vs else if) deferred — conditions are mutually exclusive.

findings.problem: Both commit messages use a lowercase first word: 'EPMCDME-9314: show-scroll on Table...' and 'EPMCDME-9314: initialise useSidebarOffsetClass...'
findings.impact: The project git-workflow.md enforces regex ^EPMCDME-(?!0+)\d+:\s[A-Z][a-z]*.* via Tekton CI. Both commits will block the MR merge pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Rebase and amend both commit messages to capitalize the first word, e.g. 'EPMCDME-9314: Fix invisible horizontal scrollbar in Table component' and 'EPMCDME-9314: Fix pagination offset flash in useSidebarOffsetClass'

business_review.criterion: Horizontal scrollbar on the table is visible and styled (matches .show-scroll style in main.scss) in Chrome, Firefox, and Safari on both affected pages
business_review.notes: show-scroll added correctly behind the !embedded guard; defined in main.scss with full WebKit (-webkit-scrollbar) and Firefox (scrollbar-width/scrollbar-color) coverage

business_review.criterion: Pagination bar renders at the correct left offset from the first mount — no flash or jump visible
business_review.notes: Lazy useState initializer eliminates the null-on-first-render gap; computeOffsetClass reads the Valtio store synchronously which is initialized before the hook runs

business_review.criterion: No regression on other pages that use Table (embedded={true} must not gain a scrollbar)
business_review.notes: show-scroll is gated inside { 'overflow-auto min-h-[300px] show-scroll': !embedded }; 10+ embedded table callers confirmed unaffected by edge-case lens

standards_review.notes: Both commits violate the EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence rule — first words 'show-scroll' and 'initialise' are lowercase. CI-blocking per .ai-run/guides/standards/git-workflow.md
No security surface in this diff; no secrets, no auth, no user input handling changed
